features.name: Greeting + Green Live Dot
features.vision_statement: The rotating greetings ('Let's build something great,' etc.) with the green 'live' dot are the whole top of home
features.code_evidence: Green live dot with glow (lines 26-32); H1 greeting rotating from GREETINGS array (lines 33-47)
features.notes: R57 hygiene pass removed last-login stamp, success-rate chip, time-aware sub-line. Greeting + dot only.

features.name: Real-Time Search (5 types)
features.vision_statement: Real-time search with filtered sections: messages, chats, agents, tasks (and files per 2026-04-23 ratification)
features.code_evidence: Messages (ilike text), Tasks (title+text ilike), Files (API auth fetch), Agents (in-memory filter), Projects (in-memory filter). All five types returned in useHomeSearch return object.
features.notes: R68 added files support (June 2026). Placeholder text omits 'files' (trivial fix). All five data types fully searched and returned.

features.name: Chronological Ordering by Last Message
features.vision_statement: Lists are chronologically ordered by last message, always. When a message arrives, that agent/project moves to top.
features.code_evidence: chronoAgents sorted by latest message timestamp (lines 208-228); chronoProjects sorted same way (lines 228-240); applyOrder applies user's drag override after sort.
features.notes: Default is chronological; drag-override applied when user reorders. Lists feel alive.

features.name: EA Hero Pin (Default) + Universal Pin/Unpin
features.vision_statement: EA hero pinned by default. Pin/unpin is universal affordance (three-dot menu) on every agent and project card.
features.code_evidence: PinMenu rendered on EA card (EaHeroCard:68); EA conditionally renders based on pinState (ConversationsView:306); pin/unpin handlers passed to all lists.
features.notes: R58 generalized EA-specific button to universal PinMenu pattern. Pinned items at top, unpinned fall to main list.

features.name: Drag-to-Reorder Within Lists
features.vision_statement: Drag-to-reorder inside agents and projects lists. Reorder persists. Chronological is default; drag overrides.
features.code_evidence: useListOrder manages agentOrder and projectOrder state; applyOrder applies override after chronological sort; handlers passed to lists.
features.notes: State persisted via localStorage. Reorder sticks across page reload.

features.name: Time-of-Day-Aware Greetings
features.vision_statement: R57 original: no time-aware 'Good morning' sub-line. R57-REVERSE (2026-05-05): greetings should vary by time of day (morning/afternoon/evening/late-night).
features.code_evidence: timeVariant() computed (lines 15-21); variant set on data-variant (line 35). GREETINGS array shows generic time-agnostic strings; no branching by time.
features.notes: Infrastructure ready. 2026-05-05 reversal requires greeting copy to vary by time. Two paths in VISION-pending: light-touch (add prefix like 'Morning, Patrik') or cut-scene integration. NOT YET SHIPPED.

features.name: Cut-Scene on User Return
features.vision_statement: When user returns, cut-scene plays: EA narrates what's open (stale projects, agents needing input, pending approvals, etc.).
features.code_evidence: Fetched on mount from 'stale-project-nudge' messages (lines 217-237); filters unresolved items; renders CutsceneOverlay when items exist (lines 912-918).
features.notes: Live with stale-project-nudge item source (R75-c1). VISION-pending lists 6 planned sources (nudges, needs_input, approvals, unanswered DMs, skill recs, recovery). Follow-up tracked in corner:cutscene-on-entry mission.

features.name: EA Hero Status + Last Message + Unread Badge
features.vision_statement: Implicit in Pillar 1; EA hero shows status, last message, unread badge (same pattern as all agent cards per R58).
features.code_evidence: Props: eaStatusInfo, eaLastMsg, eaUnread, eaIsActive passed to EaHeroCard; rendered visually.
features.notes: No explicit vision citation (implicit requirement), but fully shipped on all agent cards.

top_gaps.impact: 2026-05-05 reversal of R57 requires greeting copy to vary by time, but current GREETINGS array shows generic strings only.
top_gaps.recommendation: Implement time-scoped greeting selection (light touch) OR fold into cut-scene (medium effort). Infrastructure ready; copy layer missing.

top_gaps.impact: HomeSearchBar placeholder says 'messages, tasks, agents, projects' but omits 'files' (supported since R68).
top_gaps.recommendation: One-line edit to include 'files' in placeholder text.

top_gaps.issue: Cut-Scene Limited to Single Item Source
top_gaps.impact: Currently pulls only stale-project-nudge. VISION lists 6 planned sources; only 1 wired.
top_gaps.recommendation: Tracked in corner:cutscene-on-entry mission. Prioritize needs_input + pending approvals as next sources.
top_gaps.effort_estimate: medium (depends on needs_input + approval system integration)

code_quality.structure: Well-organized. ConversationsView extracted child components to conversations/ subdir. Clear separation of concerns.
code_quality.comments: Good annotation: R57, R58, R75-b3 round references throughout. Helps future readers understand design decisions.
code_quality.testing: testid attributes set on greeting, EA card, search input. Aligns with R19/R57/R58 test expectations.
code_quality.state_management: Feature-sliced context + custom hooks (usePinned, useListOrder, useHomeSearch). Coherent, no N+1 queries.
code_quality.persistence: Pin and drag-order state via localStorage. Survives page reload.
code_quality.performance: Search debounced (220ms); Promise.all gates file search. No obvious bottlenecks.

recommendation.rationale: Core experience (greeting + search + EA focus + real-time lists) is fully built and shipping. One feature (time-of-day copy) is infrastructure-ready but awaiting implementation decision. Cut-scene live with first item source; follow-up sources planned. Home surface is user-facing launch-ready.
must_haves_before_launch: Time-of-day greeting copy implementation (if including in launch scope)
